declarations.name: x-stack
declarations.description: Vertical stack layout behavior. Renders children in a column with configurable gap, background color, padding, and border radius.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: CSS gap between stacked children. Accepts any valid CSS length value.

attributes.name: bg
attributes.description: Background color of the stack. Accepts any valid CSS color value including hex, rgb, and CSS variables.

attributes.name: pad
attributes.description: CSS padding shorthand applied to the stack element. Accepts any valid CSS padding value (1–4 values). Use '0 0 0.75rem' to pad bottom only (e.g. when image bleeds to top/side edges).

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: CSS border-radius applied to the stack element. Accepts any valid CSS border-radius value.
